Class LobbyAnimator

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.LobbyAnimator
public class LobbyAnimator extends Object
Owns all JavaFX transitions for the lobby screen. Contains no state-machine logic.

  • Method Details

    • animateWelcomeToChoice

      public void animateWelcomeToChoice(Runnable onFinished)
      WELCOME → CHOICE: slides the logo to the top, fades out the totem strip, fades in the form.
      Parameters:
      onFinished - called on the JavaFX thread when the form is fully visible

    • animateChoiceToWelcome

      public void animateChoiceToWelcome(Runnable onFinished)
      CHOICE → WELCOME: reverse of animateWelcomeToChoice(Runnable). Slides the logo and totem strip back to the welcome layout and fades the form out.
      Parameters:
      onFinished - called on the JavaFX thread when the welcome layout is restored

    • animateToTotemSelection

      public void animateToTotemSelection(Runnable onFinished)
      Transitions from the form area to the full totem selection screen. The totemSelection panel starts from the small top position (where welcomeTotems settled after WELCOME→CHOICE) and animates to the centre at full size.
      Parameters:
      onFinished - called on the JavaFX thread when the animation completes; may be null

    • markTotemUnavailable

      public void markTotemUnavailable(javafx.scene.image.ImageView totemImage, javafx.scene.control.Label ownerLabel, String ownerNick)
      Applies a desaturation effect to a totem image and shows the owner's nickname label.
      Parameters:
      totemImage - the totem ImageView to grey out
      ownerLabel - label that will display the owner's nickname
      ownerNick - nickname of the player who took the totem

    • markTotemSelected

      public void markTotemSelected(javafx.scene.image.ImageView totemImage)
      Highlights the selected totem with a CSS class and a subtle scale-up.
      Parameters:
      totemImage - the ImageView to highlight

    • clearTotemSelection

      public void clearTotemSelection(javafx.scene.image.ImageView totemImage)
      Removes the highlight from a previously selected totem.
      Parameters:
      totemImage - the ImageView to reset

    • shake

      public void shake(javafx.scene.Node node, String errorMessage)
      Shakes a node horizontally and shows an error message below the form.

      errorMessage - text to display in the error label

    • startWaitingAnimation

      public void startWaitingAnimation(javafx.scene.control.Label label)
      Starts an indefinite "Waiting..." animation on the given label: dots disappear one at a time cyclically (Waiting... → Waiting.. → Waiting. → Waiting → Waiting... → ...).
      Parameters:
      label - the label to animate; will be made visible

    • stopWaitingAnimation
